title: Momina salza · the thermal complex
figure: Fig. 37 · after Madzharov, Tancheva, Madzharov 2021a: 705, fig. 1 · Avramova 2024, digital p. 289 / printed p. 285
scope: The solid-black masonry around the five rooms labelled in Fig. 37 and their adjoining southern junctions. Source names (caldaria 1a, 1, 2; tepidaria 1, 2) are retained as published labels, not settled functional interpretations. The separate Toplitsa bath (Fig. 15) and the other springs are not combined with this footprint.
limitation: A relief of the published plan, not an elevation or a single historical phase. Uniform display height is not archaeological height. Small white aperture marks are retained as source symbols, without assigning channel routes, depth, or function. Floor textures, drainage/pavement lines, patterned rubble, western excavation hatching, ambiguous detached marks, and the southern continuation are visible in the source but not raised. No roof, arch, column, water level, or missing fabric is reconstructed.

features.label: Recorded masonry
features.note: Solid-black masonry boundaries and enclosed white marks follow Fig. 37. Patterned fabric and detached drawing marks remain in the source layer. Allow approximately ±2 pixels for interpreting and sampling this raster, not as survey or real-world dimensional accuracy. White marks are preserved without a reconstructed vertical profile.
